## 1. Historical Background / 历史背景

### The Long Journey to Backpropagation / 反向传播的漫长历程

```
Timeline of Backpropagation Development / 反向传播发展时间线
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1960s  → Control theory researchers develop sensitivity analysis
         控制理论研究者发展了敏感性分析

1974   → Paul Werbos proposes backpropagation for neural networks
         Werbos为神经网络提出反向传播

1982   → Werbos publishes "Learning Logic" (largely unnoticed)
         Werbos发表《学习逻辑》(未受关注)

1986   → ★ Rumelhart, Hinton & Williams publish landmark paper
         Rumelhart, Hinton & Williams发表里程碑论文

         "Learning representations by back-propagating errors"

1990s  → Backpropagation becomes standard training method
         反向传播成为标准训练方法

2012   → AlexNet wins ImageNet, deep learning revolution begins
         AlexNet赢得ImageNet比赛，深度学习革命开始
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```

### Why Was It Revolutionary? / 为什么它是革命性的？

```
Before Backprop / 反向传播之前:
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  • Hebbian learning (fire together, wire together)│
│    赫布学习（一起放电，一起连接）                  │
│  • Perceptron learning rule (linear only)        │
│    感知机学习规则（仅限线性）                     │
│  • Very shallow networks, limited capability     │
│    网络很浅，能力有限                            │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

After Backprop / 反向传播之后:
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  • Efficient computation of gradients            │
│    高效计算梯度                                  │
│  • Train deep networks / 训练深层网络            │
│  • Learn complex, non-linear representations     │
│    学习复杂的非线性表示                           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Mathematical Foundation / 数学基础

### 2.1 Chain Rule: The Heart of Backpropagation / 链式法则：反向传播的核心

```
Chain Rule Formula / 链式法则公式:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If: y = f(g(x))
Then: dy/dx = (df/dg) × (dg/dx)

如果: y = f(g(x))
那么: dy/dx = (df/dg) × (dg/dx)

Visual Representation / 可视化表示:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

    x ──→ [g] ──→ g(x) ──→ [f] ──→ y
           │                      │
           │ dy/dg                │
           └──────────────────────┘
                    ↓
           dy/dx = (dy/dg) × (dg/dx)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
```
